datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2014 for Zambia. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity phases (IPC classifications) across administrative units, with multiple scenarios and collection dates (January, April, July, October). Geographic boundaries and classification values were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for spatial analysis.
